overview: The Medford Conservation Commission continued a Notice of Intent for the South Reservoir Dam improvements, approved an Order of Conditions for dugout replacements at Veterans Memorial Park, and adopted provisions regarding electronic signatures. The commission also discussed reallocating or withdrawing a previously awarded CPA grant for stormwater mitigation.

items.title: South Reservoir Dam Improvements Notice of Intent
items.summary: Continued the hearing to November 29, 2023, pending commission review of recently submitted materials and further coordination regarding tree mitigation and invasive species removal plans.

items.title: CPA Riverside Avenue Stormwater Award Discussion
items.summary: Discussed the status of a past $40,000 CPA grant for Riverside Avenue stormwater mitigation, exploring whether to formally withdraw the funds or transfer them to the Medford Housing Authority to fulfill the original project scope.

items.title: Veterans Memorial Park Dugout Replacement Notice of Intent
items.summary: Approved an Order of Conditions with special conditions addressing material removal, concrete washout containment, prohibition of overnight equipment storage, and maintenance of public pathway access during construction.

items.title: Electronic Signatures and Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Voted to accept the provisions of Massachusetts General Law Chapter 110G regarding electronic signatures and approved two sets of prior meeting minutes as corrected.
